description: We are gonna work on the health monitoring challenge, aiming to tackle both hardware and software!
summary: We developed software and hardware that is used to assist and optimize astronauts' workouts in space, which addresses the challenge by helping improve astronauts' health. This is important for astronauts because they will lose bone mass in space without proper exercise, and this makes sure that in real time they are aware of hitting the required exercise intensity.
details:
Hardware:
3 x three axis accelerometers measuring data from your thigh, pelvis, and tibia. They are all connected to an ESP32C3, which sends data over USB serial to the software.

AI / ML:
The model is a hybrid combination of a ML model with a Neural Network, called a k-NN classifier. The input commands are accelerometer data, sampled into bins and given Z scores. It it then validated against the model, both trained on NASA Life Sciences data and tested on accelerometer workouts done by our team. Our current model accuracy is around 97-98%.
dataRefs: NASA Life Sciences Data Archive (LSDA): MR035G Bone densitometry (DXA), bed rest Campaign 3
NASA Life Sciences Data Archive (LSDA): MR079G Isokinetic muscle function, bed rest Campaign 3
